posts.title: Pocket Dev demo: Claude Code, Codex, Git and terminals from your phone
posts.caption:
A wide-screen walkthrough of Pocket Dev: use real terminals, Claude Code, Codex, Git, files and multiple computers from your phone's browser.

Pocket Dev is free and open source. It runs on your own computer and uses your existing coding-agent accounts. Nothing to install on the phone and no Pocket Dev cloud account.

Source and setup: https://github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev
Full guide: https://www.theani.me/work/pocket-dev/docs

Demo data, scripted agent responses and a simulated install scene are shown. Same Wi-Fi by default; optional remote access needs setup and an awake computer.

posts.caption:

This is an alternate ending, not an audience-selected result. Both alternate endings are being shared as separate fictional outcomes.

Pocket Dev is the real, free and open-source app shown in this illustrated story. Demo project. Remote access configured; computer on and awake. The fictional alert comes from an external uptime monitor; Pocket Dev does not send notifications to a locked phone.
